g.text: Can I ask you a... potentially strange question?
You've been poisoning it, haven't you?!
You wish. No getting out that easy.
I'm curious why you cut it up into... perfect squares. Even the pizza.
Honestly? It kind of reminds me of... I don't know.
Force of habit. That's how the rations were served on the Zariman, the ship that got stuck in the void.
The only home I've had where I wasn't alone.
Actually, sorry. I don't want to talk about it. [End.]
When it wasn't just me, myself, and my cubed food rations.
Well, I guess I could try making square spaghetti if you want.
So. I guess I do it because there's comfort in it.
I'll tell you what. If you make it, I'll eat it.
I know how you feel. Routines can help you feel grounded, especially when everything's gone to shit.
I tell you what - I make a mean cubed omelette.
Chat ends. Next chat will be ArthurSpaghetti.
